llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Cue fact-checking integration that sends user-provided material to an external service and saves reports locally.

dimensions.detail: Use of git, python3, curl, a Cue API key, and network calls to cuecue.cn is proportionate for this external fact-checking service, but submitted content leaves the local environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains no executable installer, but it refers users to an external runner under ~/.cue/cue-skills and a GitHub/Gitee source, so users should inspect that runner before first use.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to running a single Cue research command and returning the resulting report; the 'do not cancel' workflow note should not override explicit user direction.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The documented command writes Markdown reports to ~/cue-reports and health checks read ~/.cue/config.json or CUE_API_KEY; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned but can persist sensitive source material.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is fact-checking through Cue, and the runtime instructions, template ID, external API use, and structured report output all align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before using this skill, assume your fact-check query, links, source excerpts, and API metadata may be sent to cuecue.cn and processed with external data sources. Avoid submitting secrets, regulated data, or confidential due-diligence material unless that use is approved, and store or delete generated reports according to their sensitivity.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The external submission concern is valid user guidance, but the artifact does disclose the Agent -> Cue API -> external data source architecture and the behavior is central to the skill's purpose.
[SQP-2] expected: The local report persistence concern is valid user guidance, but the command explicitly includes an --output path and report generation is expected for the workflow.
